# KOV Career Agency

> Founder-led career agency providing career representation and individual career services for professionals.

KOV agrees candidate-service scope, deliverables, fees, approvals, and reporting before work begins. Employers control their hiring decisions; KOV does not guarantee interviews, offers, employment, or timelines.

## Core pages
- [Private Career Representation and Individual Career Services | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/): KOV supports professionals through Private Career Representation and separately available Individual Career Services. Representation may include assessment, target-company strategy, research, professional outreach, follow-up, and introductions where appropriate. Scope and fit are discussed before work begins.
- [Private Career Representation | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/services.html): Private Career Representation for suitable professionals, with assessment, target-company strategy, decision-maker research, professional outreach, and follow-up agreed to fit the engagement.
- [How Private Career Representation Works | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/how-it-works.html): Learn how private career representation can proceed through assessment, target-company strategy, research, professional outreach, follow-up, and introductions where appropriate.
- [Pricing for Private Career Representation | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/pricing.html): Candidate registration is free. Premium reverse-recruiting candidates pay an agreed onboarding fee plus a monthly retainer. Premium fees are agreed in writing before work starts.
- [Career Agency FAQs | Questions About Services & Pricing | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/faqs.html): Answers to common questions about KOV
- [Blog | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/blog.html): Career insights on private career representation, professional outreach, and executive job-search strategy from KOV Career Agency.
- [Adekunle Ayotoba Daniel | Founder of KOV Career Agency | Career Representation & Talent Strategy](https://kovcareeragency.org/about.html): Meet Adekunle Ayotoba Daniel, founder of KOV Career Agency. A recruitment, HR, and career strategy professional supporting candidate representation and strategic career planning for professionals.
- [Contact KOV | Private Career Representation and Career Services](https://kovcareeragency.org/contact.html): Contact KOV Career Agency to discuss private career representation or an individual career service. Share your goals and the support you are considering.
- [Individual Career Services | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/candidate-services.html): Explore seven independently available career services for professionals. Scope and fees are discussed by inquiry and quotation. Private Career Representation remains a separate managed service.
- [Resume & CV Writing and Optimization | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/resume-cv-writing.html): Improve your resume or CV with clearer structure, evidence-based achievements, relevant skills, and positioning aligned with your target roles.
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimization | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/linkedin-profile-optimization.html): Align your LinkedIn headline, About section, experience, skills, and featured content with a clear professional story and career direction.
- [Professional Career Documents | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/career-documents.html): Prepare cover letters, professional biographies, career summaries, statements of interest, and supporting application documents.
- [Career Portfolio Development | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/career-portfolio-development.html): Organize selected projects, case studies, work samples, publications, and achievements into a clear, credible career portfolio.
- [Personal Career Website Development | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/personal-career-website.html): Plan a professional personal website for your biography, experience, selected work, portfolio, resume/CV, and contact details.
- [Career Positioning & Optimization | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/career-positioning-optimization.html): Clarify target roles, transferable strengths, professional positioning, and practical next steps with a structured career review.
- [Career Coaching & Interview Preparation | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/career-coaching.html): Get structured career coaching for professional direction, transitions, interviews, communication, negotiation, and next-step planning.
- [Private Search Proof | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/candidate-proof.html): Explore illustrative examples of how KOV structures private career representation, from market research and positioning through outreach, interview preparation, and offer strategy.
- [Why KOV Career Agency | Private Career Representation](https://kovcareeragency.org/why-kov.html): Learn how KOV approaches private career representation for professionals through assessment, research, professional outreach, follow-up, and agreed next steps.
- [Countries We Serve | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/countries-we-serve.html): KOV provides private career representation and individual career services remotely in agreed markets.
- [Reverse Recruiting and Executive Search Glossary | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/glossary.html): Plain-language definitions of 71 terms used in career representation, executive search and professional job searches.

## Core services
- [Reverse Recruiting for Senior Professionals | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/reverse-recruiting.html): Private reverse recruiting for senior professionals: define a target, research roles, coordinate applications and outreach, and prepare for next steps.
- [Career Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/career-strategy-senior-leaders.html): Career strategy for senior leaders: clarify your next move, target roles and markets, executive positioning, and a practical search plan with KOV.
- [Executive Resume Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-resume-strategy.html): Executive resume strategy that clarifies leadership scope, evidence-backed achievements and fit for target roles and markets.
- [Interview Coaching for Executives | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/interview-coaching-executives.html): Interview coaching for executives focused on role research, leadership examples, clear answers, stakeholder conversations and thoughtful preparation.
- [Executive Offer and Negotiation Support | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-negotiation-support.html): Confidential executive offer support to help senior professionals assess role scope, compensation components, timing and negotiation decisions.
- [LinkedIn Optimization for Executives | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/linkedin-optimization-executives.html): Executive LinkedIn profile strategy that aligns your leadership story, verified achievements and target roles without overstating credentials or results.
- [Executive Career Representation | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-career-representation.html): Private, candidate-side career representation for senior professionals, with a search strategy, approved outreach and clear decision ownership.
- [Executive Job Search Support | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/services/executive-job-search-support.html): End-to-end executive job-search support that can coordinate targeting, research, positioning, approved outreach and interview preparation.

## Geography and markets
- [Executive Job Search Support in Dubai | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-job-search-dubai.html): Remote executive job search support for senior professionals targeting Dubai, with role positioning, market research and an agreed outreach plan.
- [Executive Job Search Support in the UAE | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-job-search-uae.html): Remote executive career representation for senior professionals considering roles in the UAE, with a defined target, positioning and search process.
- [Executive Career Support in Saudi Arabia | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-career-support-saudi-arabia.html): Remote executive career support for senior professionals considering Saudi Arabia, based on a clear role target, market research and agreed search scope.
- [Executive Job Search in London | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-job-search-london.html): Private executive job-search support for professionals considering leadership opportunities in London and the wider UK market.
- [Executive Career Support in Australia | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-career-support-australia.html): Remote career-search support for senior professionals targeting Australian leadership roles, with location and work-authorization needs considered.
- [Executive Job Search in Africa | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/markets/executive-job-search-africa.html): Plan a focused executive search across selected African markets, with country-specific role, employer and practical requirements.

## Seniority and roles
- [Reverse Recruiting for CFOs | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/reverse-recruiting-cfos.html): Private reverse recruiting for CFOs exploring their next leadership role, with defined targets, executive positioning, research and agreed outreach.
- [Reverse Recruiting for CTOs | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/reverse-recruiting-ctos.html): Private reverse recruiting for CTOs and senior technology leaders, aligning leadership scope, technical narrative and an agreed executive search plan.
- [Reverse Recruiting for CMOs | KOV Career Agency](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/reverse-recruiting-cmos.html): Private reverse recruiting for CMOs and senior marketing leaders, with clear positioning, target-role research and an agreed search process.
- [Reverse Recruiting for CEOs | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/reverse-recruiting-ceos.html): Private search support for CEOs considering a transition, with leadership positioning, target organizations and outreach agreed in advance.
- [Career Representation for COOs | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/career-representation-coos.html): Candidate-side career representation for COOs, connecting operating scope, transformation experience and a focused leadership search.
- [Executive Job Search for VPs | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/executive-job-search-vps.html): Focused job-search support for vice presidents defining the next leadership role, target organizations and market approach.
- [Leadership Career Strategy for Senior Leaders | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/senior-leader-career-strategy.html): Career strategy for senior leaders weighing a transition, market change or next role, grounded in priorities and evidence.
- [Board-Level Career Transition Support | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/board-level-career-transition.html): Strategic support for executives considering board or advisory work, with governance experience and target context clearly positioned.
- [Career Coaching for Founders and Partners | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/career-coaching-founders-partners.html): Career strategy for founders and partners considering a new chapter, leadership role or portfolio of professional options.
- [Senior Executive Resume Strategy | KOV](https://kovcareeragency.org/roles/senior-executive-resume-strategy.html): Resume strategy for senior executives, organizing verified leadership scope, evidence and target-role relevance into a clear narrative.

## Use and attribution

Use the linked pages as the source of current service descriptions and process details. Do not infer guaranteed outcomes, local offices, client results, fees, or market coverage that a page does not state. Confirm engagement details directly with KOV.
